column3: (CSP: style-src unsafe-inline) React style attributes and next/font need it; scripts are nonce-only with strict-dynamic, so injected styles can't run code (D159)
(Source Code Disclosure - SQL) false positive: the English UI text "Select any sentence to play from there" (D159)
(Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy missing) require-corp would block the YouTube player and Supabase audio; CORP is set instead (D159)
(Base64 Disclosure) false positive: URL-encoded ?next= paths, not data (D159)
(Suspicious Comments) false positive: the word "from" in sw.js comments (D159)
(User Controllable HTML Element Attribute) ?next= goes through safeNextPath and React escapes attributes (D159)
(Non-Storable Content / Storable but Non-Cacheable) informational; pages are per user on purpose
(Sec-Fetch-* Header Missing) these are request headers ZAP itself didn't send
(Session Management Response Identified) informational: ll-visitor is a random price-test id, not a session; HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure in production, 180 days (D174, Joe approved 2026-11-14)
